FAQs

Which bags can be personalized?

The CORE PRO bags on this page. The Duffel in Mini 15L, Small 25L, Medium 35L and Large 51L, and the Backpack in Mini 13L, Medium 25L and Large 33L.

What can I add to my bag?

Text of your choice, like a name or your initials.

Can I choose the font and the color?

Yes. You select both on the product page before you type your text.

Can I see it before I order?

Yes. The preview shows your text on the bag, in the placement where it will be applied.

Which colors do the CORE PRO bags come in?

Every CORE PRO bag comes in Black or Mud. Color availability can change with stock.
